statement.zh: 代尔拜赫里中层平台北半与乌木神龛语境续见 Naville《代尔拜赫里神庙》II（1896）。
statement.en: At Deir el-Bahari, architectural publication of the middle platform northern half and ebony shrine contexts continues in Naville Temple of Deir el Bahari Part II (1896).
